authority: PI, 2026-09-04: narrow the stated scope of the round-1 falsification. The diagnostic measured CPU-generated self-visited states; the sealed crossover is scored on CUDA, and the device A/B showed all 8 trajectories differed in outcome.
amends: the falsification claim recorded in commit 87ea500e and in ONPOLICY_TD_ROUND1_PREFLIGHT.json's surrounding narrative
rule: APPEND, not an edit. No measurement is retracted; the NUMBERS stand exactly as recorded. Only the SCOPE of the conclusion drawn from them is narrowed.

THE_MEASUREMENT_UNCHANGED.finding: on-policy fidelity is not lower; it is marginally higher

SCOPE_CORRECTION.what_is_refuted: CPU on-policy covariate shift. On the CPU-generated self-visited distribution, the student does not lose fidelity to its teachers.
SCOPE_CORRECTION.what_is_NOT_refuted: covariate shift on the CUDA sealed-eval distribution. Round-1 states were collected on cpu; COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json and any future seal are scored on cuda. Per ONPOLICY_TD_DEVICE_AMENDMENT.json the two devices produce different trajectories (8/8 episodes differed in final score; blue mean 1.750 cpu vs 0.875 cuda), so the CUDA deployment distribution is genuinely a different distribution and was not measured by this diagnostic.
SCOPE_CORRECTION.practical_consequence: the covariate-shift hypothesis is weakened, not eliminated. The successor diagnostic is therefore run on CUDA, which removes this ambiguity as a side effect of testing something else.

SECOND_UNRESOLVED_CAVEAT_CARRIED_FORWARD.issue: agreement is an UNWEIGHTED count over decision-boundary heads. 97-98% agreement is compatible with the residual 2-3% of disagreements being concentrated at strategically pivotal decisions (a single mis-committed capture or defense) while the many agreements are trivial.
SECOND_UNRESOLVED_CAVEAT_CARRIED_FORWARD.why_this_matters_here: it would explain the otherwise odd pairing this program has measured: near-teacher imitation fidelity together with roughly halved payoff crossover (delta_A +0.0938 / delta_B +0.1406 against specialist +0.1719 / +0.2969).
